description: This file defines HTTP route handlers for browser automation actions, including click, type, hover, scroll, drag, fill, resize, wait, evaluate, close, batch actions, and response body retrieval. It integrates with Chrome MCP and Playwright for executing browser commands, and manages route registration and request processing.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Asynchronous delay function that resolves after specified milliseconds.

methods.name: browserEvaluateDisabledMessage
methods.description: Generates a message indicating that evaluate or wait actions are disabled by configuration.

methods.name: buildExistingSessionWaitPredicate
methods.description: Constructs a JavaScript predicate string based on provided wait conditions for existing browser sessions.

methods.name: waitForExistingSessionCondition
methods.description: Polls until specified wait conditions are met or timeout occurs, for existing browser sessions.

methods.name: normalizeBoundedNonNegativeMs
methods.description: Converts a value to a non-negative integer within a maximum limit, throwing errors if invalid.

methods.name: countBatchActions
methods.description: Recursively counts total actions within a batch action structure.

methods.name: validateBatchTargetIds
methods.description: Ensures all batch actions target the same targetId, returns error string if mismatch.

methods.name: normalizeBatchAction
methods.description: Transforms raw input into a validated BrowserActRequest object for batch actions.

methods.name: registerBrowserAgentActRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP POST routes for /act, /response/body, and /highlight to handle browser automation commands.
